up: Retrieve IC50 activity values for the compound selonsertib and all its salt forms (including the parent compound) tested against the target Mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 5 (CHEMBL5285). Resolve the parent-child relationship using the molecule_hierarchy table to include both the parent compound and its derivatives. Return the compound preferred name (pref_name), standard_value, standard_units, and standard_relation. Filter the activities to only include records with standard_type = 'IC50'. Do not apply any row limits.
sql:
WITH parent_comp AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE LOWER(pref_name) = 'selonsertib'
),
related_compounds AS (
  SELECT mh.molregno
  FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
  JOIN parent_comp p ON mh.parent_molregno = p.molregno
  UNION
  SELECT molregno FROM parent_comp
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.pref_name,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation
FROM activities a
JOIN related_compounds rc ON a.molregno = rc.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5285'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
